output.title: When a call summary appears in the member portal
output.draft_text:
Question: When will the call summary show in the member portal?

Answer: A summary of this call will appear in the member portal within two business days. (Source: approved unit U-KNOWN-FACT. Advocates may say this to the member in their own words.)

Where to find it: The member can find the summary in the portal under [portal section or menu path where call summaries appear].

If the summary does not appear: If the summary is not in the portal after two business days, the member should [action the member should take, e.g., contact channel or phone number].

Scope: This timeframe applies to [call types or lines of business covered, e.g., pharmacy calls only or all member calls].

Exceptions: [any call types, member groups, or circumstances where a summary is not posted or takes longer, or 'None' if there are none].

How to say it to the member (example wording): "You'll be able to see a summary of today's call in your member portal within two business days, under [portal section or menu path where call summaries appear]."

[action the member should take, e.g., contact channel or phone number]
